title: Calculate allocation percentages from decimal shares
pr_body: Uses decimal inputs for allocation percentages and stores amounts in minor units.
author: codex
provenance: Original synthetic production-style change authored for benchmark v2.

bugs.title: Half-cent allocations use a different rounding policy
bugs.rationale: The documented allocation policy was half-up. A share yielding exactly x.5 cents now rounds to the nearest even cent, so customer invoice lines and reconciled totals differ at tie boundaries.
